Spec written to `.hermes/fable-wallet-card-spec.md`. No code files modified, nothing committed.

## What the spec covers

Grounded in the real code I read (`OrderCertCard.tsx`, `certs.ts`, `authorizeNetClient.ts`, `Checkout.tsx`, `authorizeNet.ts`, `schema.ts`), all 7 required sections:

1. **Checkout add-on UX** — opt-in row in the summary rail (kept visually secondary per Onsite > Hands-on > Online), per-seat quantity stepper for teams, folds into the existing discounted-subtotal → 3% surcharge pipeline, extends the existing `POST /api/authorize-net/charge` payload with a `photoIdAddOn` object. Photo collection is **deferred entirely** (even for individuals) so managers can buy for others.

2. **Dashboard reorder** — 5 steps → 3 (Photo → Review+Pay → Done), step 1 required upload via existing `processPhotoFile`, prepaid-entitlement branch that skips payment, plus a group-admin `TeamPhotoIdStatus` view with a 4-state status model.

3. **Shipping at checkout** — new section with "why we collect this" copy, saved to `users.savedShippingAddress`/`savedBillingAddress` (not `orders`), prefill-as-default rules.

4. **CIM** — `createCustomerProfileFromTransactionRequest` after first approved charge (never a second card handling), `chargeSavedCard` via `createCustomerProfileTransactionRequest`, token + display-only columns on `users`, sandbox/prod isolation using existing `AUTHORIZE_*` env vars, no credential changes.

5. **Edge cases** — all five, including partial add-on refund via existing `refundTransaction` as an admin-only action, address snapshotting, expired saved card fallback.

6. **Migration/rollout** — 3 PR-sized chunks with boundaries marked inline, `platform_settings` feature flags defaulting off, no backfill for legacy `cert_card_orders`.

## Key design decision worth flagging

The hardest tension is that `cert_card_orders.certificationId` is **NOT NULL** but at course checkout no certification exists yet. I recommend a new **`photo_id_entitlements`** table (Option B) rather than loosening that FK — it preserves the charge-first invariant and keeps `cert_card_orders` meaning "a card we will print," with the real row created only when the photo arrives. Two locale keys, all new strings listed in both EN + ES, no en-dashes.

If you'd prefer Option A (nullable `certificationId` + `enrollmentId` on `cert_card_orders`) to avoid a new table, that's a one-section swap — say the word.
